thread:
alexandra: Heads-up — vendor (Zenith Supply) just called: H100 batch ETA pushed ~14 days. They also reported a warehouse network cutover that paused outbound scanning this morning, so several AWBs are in limbo. We have 40 units in that wave for Dedicated pool A.
ravi: Can you drop the PO and AWB numbers here? need to check manifest + whether it's partial or full hold.
maria: tagging ops: @ops-bot can you confirm depot network status and whether the scanner outage impacted serial ingest?
ops-bot: warehouse-net-cutover: status=flapping, first_detected=2025-11-12T03:12:00Z, affected_services=[intake-api, awb-scanner], recent_error=503. Current workaround: manual manifest upload only. ETA for stable network ~6h.
sam: If ETA is 6h we can still make ground pickup windows, but if vendor wants to hold we should evaluate reroute to NL depot (2h transit) or air-expedite (same-day) — air = +$25k and vendor accepts partial shipments.
linda-vendor: confirming from my side: we can do a partial release of 20/40 units today if Redwood accepts adjusted invoice terms: 10% holdback until serial reconciliation + standard RMA paperwork. If you require full release we need ship/insurance recalc.
kevin: what's our tolerance for 10% holdback? for Dedicated customers that could mean failing capacity SLOs. Also need to confirm we can ingest partial manifest into provisioning pipeline without breaking allocation.
alexandra: short answers: 1) we can't degrade Dedicated SLOs; 2) partial is OK if we swap-in borrowed nodes from staging for the 2-week gap (ops cost) and vendor covers expedite fee if they miss SLA. Proposal: accept 20 units now with escrow for the rest, require vendor to generate temp AWB + CSV manifest.
maria: ops: can you do a manual serial ingest for the 20 units and run reconciliation? @ops-bot any rate limits on manual pushes?
ops-bot: manual_ingest_allowed=true, max_batch=500 serials per push, endpoint=/internal/ingest/manual. Expect ~15min processing per 500.
ravi: PO=PO-8721, vendor-awb=AWB-ZEN-55931. uploading vendor manifest now.
ravi: curl snippet for manifest pull if someone else needs it:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.zenith-supply.example.com/manifests/AWB-ZEN-55931/download -o manifest_AWB-55931.csv
```
sam: cost delta calc: accept partial + staging borrow = ~$2k/day infra ops for two weeks (~$28k) vs air expedite $25k — looks similar; pick cheaper path based on SLA exposure.
linda-vendor: if you choose partial release + holdback we will issue an interim invoice and provide the RMA prefix you requested. We need your RMA format to tie returns/DOA to this shipment.
kevin: RMA prefix we use: RMD-YYYY-NNNN. Example payload to include with vendor manifest:
```
{
  "rma_prefix": "RMD-2025-",
  "expected_return_window_days": "30",
  "qa_checks": ["serial_match", "boot_test"]
}
```
alexandra: action items: @ravi confirm manifest ingest complete within 30m; @maria + ops to run manual ingest & reconciliation; @kevin prepare RMA prefix and notify SCM; @sam hold staging-borrow plan and quote cost to finance. I'll ping legal about adjusted invoice terms (10% holdback).
ravi: manifest ingested, initial serials count=20, can't find 2 serials in vendor list — flagged to vendor.
linda-vendor: ack — will reconcile missing 2 serials and send AWB update by EOD. We can also push the remaining 20 once network stabilizes.
maria: manual ingest finished, serial reconciliation shows 18/20 matched; we quarantined 2 for vendor follow-up. provisioning pipeline staged 18 units for allocation rule "dedicated-A-fairshare".
kevin: I've created RMA record template in our portal for this vendor and shared prefix with Linda. RMA-ID sample: RMD-2025-0042. Please include that on AWB and invoice.
alexandra: sounds good. If vendor misses the promised reconcile window (EOD) we air-expedite the rest and invoice vendor for the delta. Marking this P0 for ops until resolved. :eyes:
linda-vendor: will update by EOD. thanks for the quick coordination.
kevin: noted — I'll reconcile once vendor updates manifest and then close RMA placeholders.
sam: finance, FYI — holdback 10% flagged; will need to adjust forecasting for Dedicated pool billable units.
alexandra: closing loop: update channel when AWB updated or when vendor publishes the second wave. thanks all :thumbsup:
